# `sngl dump` is an unsupported debugging tool whose output is not tested:
# this only checks that every stage dumps in every format, with the flags that
# change what is walked, without failing. Several checked dumps run in one
# process, so a dump that wrote into the IR or ASTs every check shares fails
# the next one.

sngl dump --stage parsed --format sngl main.sngl
sngl dump --stage parsed --format spew main.sngl
sngl dump --stage parsed --format json main.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked --format sngl main.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked --format spew main.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked --format json main.sngl
sngl dump --stage optimized --platform html --lang none --format sngl main.sngl
sngl dump --stage optimized --platform html --lang none --format spew main.sngl
sngl dump --stage optimized --platform html --lang none --format json main.sngl
sngl dump --stage lowered --platform html --lang none --format sngl main.sngl
sngl dump --stage lowered --platform html --lang none --format spew main.sngl
sngl dump --stage lowered --platform html --lang none --format json main.sngl
sngl dump --stage analysis --platform html --lang none --format spew main.sngl
sngl dump --stage analysis --platform html --lang none --format json main.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked --format json --omit AST,Pos main.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked --format spew --omit AST,Pos --pointers --depth 3 main.sngl
sngl dump --stage lowered --platform html --lang none --format json --omit AST,Pos main.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked --format json main.sngl

sngl dump --stage parsed --format sngl methods.sngl
sngl dump --stage parsed --format spew methods.sngl
sngl dump --stage parsed --format json methods.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked --format sngl methods.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked --format spew methods.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked --format json methods.sngl
sngl dump --stage optimized --platform html --lang none --format sngl methods.sngl
sngl dump --stage optimized --platform html --lang none --format spew methods.sngl
sngl dump --stage optimized --platform html --lang none --format json methods.sngl
sngl dump --stage lowered --platform html --lang none --format sngl methods.sngl
sngl dump --stage lowered --platform html --lang none --format spew methods.sngl
sngl dump --stage lowered --platform html --lang none --format json methods.sngl
sngl dump --stage analysis --platform html --lang none --format spew methods.sngl
sngl dump --stage analysis --platform html --lang none --format json methods.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked --format json --omit AST,Pos methods.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked --format spew --omit AST,Pos --pointers --depth 3 methods.sngl
sngl dump --stage lowered --platform html --lang none --format json --omit AST,Pos methods.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked --format json methods.sngl

sngl dump --stage parsed --format sngl proj/app.sngl
sngl dump --stage parsed --format spew proj/app.sngl
sngl dump --stage parsed --format json proj/app.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked --format sngl proj/app.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked --format spew proj/app.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked --format json proj/app.sngl
sngl dump --stage optimized --platform html --lang none --format sngl proj/app.sngl
sngl dump --stage optimized --platform html --lang none --format spew proj/app.sngl
sngl dump --stage optimized --platform html --lang none --format json proj/app.sngl
sngl dump --stage lowered --platform html --lang none --format sngl proj/app.sngl
sngl dump --stage lowered --platform html --lang none --format spew proj/app.sngl
sngl dump --stage lowered --platform html --lang none --format json proj/app.sngl
sngl dump --stage analysis --platform html --lang none --format spew proj/app.sngl
sngl dump --stage analysis --platform html --lang none --format json proj/app.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked --format json --omit AST,Pos proj/app.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked --format spew --omit AST,Pos --pointers --depth 3 proj/app.sngl
sngl dump --stage lowered --platform html --lang none --format json --omit AST,Pos proj/app.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked --format json proj/app.sngl
stdout '"Pkg": "dir:shapes"'

# A check finding the library already loaded adopts the contexts a target
# package brings as the check that loaded it did.
sngl dump --stage checked --format json main.sngl
stdout '"Name": "palette"'
sngl dump --stage checked --format json main.sngl
stdout '"Name": "palette"'

# unwrap's parameter is an anonymous struct naming a type parameter, which is
# interned nowhere: only the types naming it write it, and spew writes as many
# as JSON does.
sngl dump --stage checked --format json generic.sngl
stdout -count=3 '"Anon": true'
sngl dump --stage checked --format spew generic.sngl
stdout -count=3 '"Anon": \(bool\) true'

# Its calls reach each other through the IR, which encoding/json met as a cycle.
sngl dump --stage checked --format json ternary.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked --format spew ternary.sngl

# A function in a generic component's body carries the component's type
# params as its receiver's, but prints by its bare name.
sngl dump --stage checked --format sngl genericbody.sngl
stdout 'func bump\('
sngl dump --stage lowered --platform bubbletea --lang go --format sngl genericbody.sngl
stdout 'func bump'

-- main.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

const greeting = "hi"

component main node {
    var n = 0
    button(text="{greeting} {n}", @click { n += 1 })
}

window {
    main
}
-- methods.sngl --

import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

func run(f func()) {
    f()
}

func applied(f func() int) => f()

component inner(@fired) node {
    var ran = 0

    func go() {
        run(func() {
            ran += 1
            fired()
        })
    }

    text(value="{ran}")
}

component main node {
    var (
        viaMethod = 0
        emitted = 0
    )

    inner #child(@fired {
        emitted += 1
    })
    func bump() {
        run(func() {
            viaMethod += 1
        })
    }

    text(value="{viaMethod}:{emitted}")
}

func testACallbackRuns(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(applied(func() => 7) == 7)
}

func testACallbackWritesALocal(t Test, c main) {
    var local = 0

    run(func() {
        local += 1
    })
    t.assert(local == 1)
}

func testACallbackWritesComponentState(t Test, c main) {
    c.bump()
    t.assert(c.viaMethod == 1)
}

func testACallbackEmits(t Test, c main) {
    c.child.go()
    t.assert(c.child.ran == 1)
    t.assert(c.emitted == 1)
}

window {
    main
}
-- proj/app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "./shapes"

component badge node {
    text(value="mine")
}

window {
    badge
    shapes.badge
}
-- proj/shapes/s.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

context[int] #depth(3)

component badge ui.node {
    ui.text(value="{depth}")
}
-- genericbody.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component counter[T any](value T) node {
    var n = 0

    func bump() {
        n += 1
    }

    text(value="{n}")
}

window {
    counter(value=1)
}
-- generic.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

func unwrap[T any](w struct { v T }) T {
    return w.v
}

window {
    text(value="{unwrap({v=2})}")
}
-- ternary.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var a int = 1
    var b int = 2
    var c int = 3

    func classify() => a > 0 ? (b > 0 ? "both+" : "aOnly") : "neither"
    func chained() => a == 1 ? "one" : a == 2 ? "two" : a == 3 ? "three" : "other"
    func deep() => (a > b) ? (a > c ? "aMax" : "cMax") : (b > c ? "bMax" : "cMax")

    text(value=classify)
}

func testTernaryGrouped(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.classify == "both+")
}

func testTernaryChain(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.chained == "one")
}

func testTernaryDeep(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.deep == "cMax")
}

window {
    main
}
